legal_chain.role: imposes tax on taxable income for individual filing-status classes
defines gross income broadly while preserving statutory inclusions and exclusions
defines adjusted gross income for an individual as gross income minus specified deductions
defines taxable income through allowed deductions and the non-itemizer rule
operationally separates taxable income, tax computation, credits, payments, refund, and amount owed

perimeter_decision.legal_tax_unit: individual return unit under applicable filing-status, residency, joint-liability, dependent, and other statutory rules
perimeter_decision.legal_base_concept: taxable income under 26 USC 63, derived from gross income and adjusted gross income through statutory inclusions, exclusions, adjustments, and deductions
perimeter_decision.legal_liability_concept: tax computed under applicable provisions before and after nonrefundable and refundable credits must remain typed separately
perimeter_decision.cash_receipt_concept: withholding, estimated payments, settlements, refunds, and credits occur on payment and fiscal reporting timelines distinct from tax-year taxable income
perimeter_decision.economic_base_concept: the resources and persons bearing the economic burden after behavioral and incidence responses; definition only, not quantified

unresolved_exclusions: timing of withholding, estimated payments, settlements, and refunds
public_warning: The current-law legal chain is source-custodied and the legal and economic concepts are now separated. This is a definition-only completion: taxable income, tax after credits, and fiscal cash receipts are not interchangeable, no economic-incidence base is quantified, and no rate may be calculated.
